Top 10 AI Movies of All Time

Media i have consumed for this video essay

  1. 2001: A Space Odyssey (1968)

    Stanley Kubrick's masterpiece featuring HAL 9000, the malevolent supercomputer.

  2. Blade Runner (1982) — Ridley Scott's neo-noir exploring what it means to be human through replicants.[ref]

  3. The Matrix (1999) — Groundbreaking sci-fi about simulated reality controlled by intelligent machines.[ref]

  4. Her (2013) — Spike Jonze's poetic story of a man falling in love with an AI operating system.[ref]

  5. Ex Machina (2014) — Tense psychological thriller about a programmer testing a humanoid AI.[ref]

  6. Ghost in the Shell (1995) — Japanese anime cyberpunk masterpiece about cyborg officers and AI consciousness.[ref]

  7. Terminator 2: Judgment Day (1991) — James Cameron's action epic about AI warfare and human survival.[ref]

  8. WALL-E (2008) — Pixar's heartwarming tale of a waste-collecting robot in a post-apocalyptic Earth.[ref]

  9. A.I. Artificial Intelligence (2001) — Steven Spielberg's emotional story of a robotic boy seeking to become real.[ref]

  10. I, Robot (2004) — Will Smith investigates a crime possibly committed by a robot in 2035.[ref]

Honorable Mentions: The Terminator (1984), Blade Runner 2049 (2017), Chappie (2015), The Creator (2023), M3GAN (2023), Bicentennial Man (1999), RoboCop (1987), Pluto (2023 anime).
